business_summary: kaihan co.,Ltd. plans, develops, and operates food and beverage establishments in Japan. it operates through three segments: Food and Beverage Business, Renewable Energy Business, and Medical Business. The company develops, power plants, and generates, and sells electricity through renewable energy resources. It also provides consulting services on the establishment and operation of medial institutions. The company was formerly known as Kaihan, Ltd. and changed its name to kaihan co.,Ltd. in October 2006. kaihan co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Nagoya, Japan.
